definition.note: Pre-COVID ends before 15 Mar 2020. Post-COVID starts 1 Jul 2020 to skip the acute lockdown spring.

ridership.note: Hyde Park / UChicago walk-up vs member usage fees. Annual dues are not subtracted because trip files have no unique riders. 2020–2021 member e-bikes are treated as included for 45 minutes: Hyde Park sat in Divvy’s original fee-waiver zone south of Pershing until May 2022.

forecast.method: seasonal same-month blend + YoY + short trend + climatology weather adjustment
learning_notes: This is an interpretable baseline, not a black-box model.
When the next Divvy archive lands, compare actual trips in target_month to predicted_trips.
Run `npm run divvy:forecast-learn` for a linear ML version with explicit features and holdout metrics.
